m: निर्—जाल्मक (निर्-), mfn. maneless, TS., Sch. (cf. -जर्जल्प).
निर्—जाड्य mfn. free from coldness, L.
निर्-जात mfn. (√ जन्) come forth, appeared, visible (ifc. in inverted order), Lalit.
a: निर्जात — a. Visible, come forth, appeared.

m: निर्-√ जॄ Caus. -जरयति, to wear down, rub to pieces, crush, ib.

v: nirjIva
tri॰ nirgato jIvo yasmAt prA॰ va॰ । jIvAjarahite dehe “vAjiBiScApi nirjIvEH SvasadBiH SocitokzitEH” mA॰ dro॰ 49 a॰ । nirjIvatulyErityarTaH । “citA dahati nirjIvaM cintA dahati jIvitam” prAcInamATA ।
m: निर्—जीव mf(आ)n. lifeless, dead, MBh. &c.
निर्—जीव—करण n. killing, striking dead (with gen.), Kathās. xvii, 15 (w.r. -कार्˚)
निर्—जी˚वित mfn. = -जीव
निर्—जी˚वि˚त-त्व n., Vajracch.
निर्—ज्ञान mf(आ)n. ignorant, stupid, silly, Kathās.
निर्—ज्ञाति mfn. having no kinsfolk, MBh.

v: nirjalEkAdaSI

strI karma॰ । jyEzWasya SuklEkAdaSyAm yaTAhapAdme BImasenaM prati vyAsaH । “vfzasTe miTugasTe'rke SuklA hyekAdaSI hi yA । jyEzWe mAsi prayatnena sopAsyA jalavarjitA । snAne cAcamane cEva varjayitvo dakaM buDaH । upayuYjIta nEvAnyad vrataBaNgo'nyaTA Bavet । udayAdudayaM yAvad varjayitvA jalaM buDaH । aprayatnAdavApnoti dvAdaSadvAdaSI Palamiti” ।
m: निर्—ज˚लैकादशी f. the 11th day in the light half of the month Jyaiṣṭha (on which even the drinking of water is forbidden), Col.

v: nirjala
tri॰ nirgataM jalaM yasmAt prA॰ ba॰ । jalaSUnye deSe “kozaYca janayedrAjA nirjaleByo yaTA jalam” BA॰ SA॰ 130 a॰ ।
m: निर्—जल mf(आ)n. waterless, dry (m. or n. a dry country, desert, waste, MBh.; R.)
not mixed with water (as buttermilk), L.
निर्—जलद mf(आ)n. cloudless, Subh.
निर्—ज˚ल-मीनाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to be like a fish without water, Bhām.
निर्—ज˚ल-तोयदाभ mfn. of the colour of a waterless cloud i.e. white, fair, MW.

v: nirjana
tri॰ nirgato jano yasmAt prA॰ va॰ । janEranAkIrRe vijane ।
m: निर्—जन mf(आ)n. unpeopled, lonely, desolate, MBh.; R.
निर्—जन m. or n. solitude, desert, R.; Rājat.
निर्—जन—ता f. (Rājat.) depopulation, voidness
निर्—जन—त्व n. (Sah.) depopulation, voidness
निर्—जन—वन n. a lonely or unfrequented forest, MW.
निर्—जन्तु mfn. free from living creatures (worms &c.), HYog.
निर्—जरा f. Cocculus Cordifolius or Anethum Graveolens, L.

v: nirjarAyu
pu॰ nirmato jarAyutaH nirA॰ ta॰ । jarAnuto nirgate nfgavAdO । nirgato jarAyuryasya । 3 jarAyuhAne tri॰ । “aBUH pAre pfdAkkastrizaptAnirjarAyavaH । tAsAM jarAyuBirvayamakzyAvapi” aTa॰ 1 । 27 । 1
m: निर्—जरायु (निर्-), mfn. (snake) that has cast its skin, AV.

v: nirjaraM

pu॰ nirgatA jarA yasmAt । 1 deve 2 jarASUnye tri॰ । 5 ba॰ । 3 amfte na॰ । jarASabdasya gORatve'pi ajAdO pratyaye pare vA jarasAdeSaH nirjarasO nirjarO । ArhatamatasidDe jIvAjIvAdizu saptasu padArzezu 4 padArTaBede ArhataSabde 395 pf॰ dfSyam । 5 guqUcyAM 6 tAlaparRyAM ca strI medi॰ ।
m: 1. निर्—जर mfn. (in some cases ˚रस्, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 101) not becoming old, young, fresh, BhP.
imperishable, immortal, W.
निर्—जर m. a god, Rājat.
निर्—जर n. ambrosia or nectar, L.
2. निर्-˚जर mfn. (for 1. See p. 541) completely wearing down or destroying, Col.
निर्-˚जर m. (with Jainas) the gradual destruction of all actions (also f(आ). and ˚रण n.), HYog.; Sarvad.
निर्-˚जरण n., (with Jainas) the gradual destruction of all actions
निर्—जर—पण्य-योषित् f. ‘immortal courtezan’, an Apsaras, Vcar.
निर्-˚जर—प्रकरणादि m. N. of wk.

k.v: अमरा निर्जरा देवास्त्रिदशा विबुधाः सुराः। सुपर्वाणः सुमनसस्त्रिदिवेशा दिवौकसः॥

v: nirjarasarzapa
pu॰ nirjarapriyaH sarzapaH SA॰ ta॰ । devasarzape rAjani॰ ।
m: निर्—जर—सर्षप m. a species of mustard, L.

v: nirjarjalpa
pu॰ nitarAM jarjaraH pfzo॰ । atyantajarjarIBUte “nirftiM nirjarjalpena SIrzRA (prIRAmi) yaju॰ 25 । 2 “nitarAM jarjarIBUtena SiroBAgena” vedadI॰ ।
m: निर्—जर्जल्प (निर्-), mfn. tattered, VS. (Mahīdh.; v.l. TS. -जाल्मक).
निर्-˚जय m. conquest, complete victory, subduing, mastering, MBh.; Kāv.; Suśr. &c.
a: निर्जयः, --निर्जितिः — f. Complete victory, subjugation, vanquishing.

m: निर्-˚जेतृ m. a conqueror, vanquisher, R.
निर्-√ जि P. -जयति (pf. -जिगाय ind.p. -जित्य), to conquer, win (in battle, play &c.), acquire; subdue, vanquish, surpass, Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: निर्जि — {c1c} P. 1 To conquer, defeat; R. 3. 51; Bk. 2. 52; 7. 94; Y. 3. 292. --2 To win, acquire by conquest; Ms. 8. 154. --3 To vanquish in a play. --4 To surpass, excel.

m: निर्-जिगमिषु mfn. (√ गम्) wishing to go out or come forth, Kād.; Hcar.
निर्-जिहीर्षु mfn. (√ हृ) wishing to take off or remove, BhP.

v: nirjihva

tri॰ nirgatA muKAnniHsftA jihvA yasya । 1 muKAdvahirgataramane । “nirjihvESca SvasadBiSca kUjadBiSca gatAmuBiH । hayErvaBO naraSrezWa!” BA॰ BI॰ 90 a॰ । 2 jihvASUnye Beke ca ajihvaSabde 92 pf॰ dfSyam ।
m: निर्—जिह्व mfn. tongueless, MBh.
निर्—जिह्व n. a frog, L.
निर्—जिज्ञास mfn. not desirous of knowing or understanding, Nyāyas., Sch.
निर्-˚जि˚तारि-गण mfn. one who has conquered hosts of enemies, MW.

v: nirjita
tri॰ nir + ji--kta । 1 parAjite 2 vaSIkfte “nirjitErAvatA gajAH” kumA॰ । nirjitendriyagrAmaH amaraH ।
m: निर्-˚जित mfn. conquered, subdued, gained, won, ib.
claimed i.e. due (as interest on money), Mn. viii, 154
a: निर्जित — p. p. 1 Conquered completely, vanquished. --2 Acquired, gained, won. --3 Claimed.

m: निर्-˚जित—वर्मन् m. N. of a man, Rājat.
निर्-˚जि˚तेन्द्रिय mfn. one who has subdued (the whole assemblage of) his passions or feelings
निर्-˚जि˚तेन्द्रिय-ग्राम mfn. one who has subdued (the whole assemblage of) his passions or feelings (also m. ‘a Muni, a saint’), W.
निर्-˚जिति f. = -जय, Śāntiś.

s: tri, (nirgato jIvo jIvAtmA yasmAt .) jIvAtmarahitaH । prARiprUnyaH । yaTA, -- “citA cintA dbayormmaDye cintA eva garIyasI । citA dahati nirjjIvaM cindA dahati jIvitam ॥” iti prAYcaH ॥

strI, (nirjjalA ekAdaSI .) jyEzWamAsIyaSuklEkAdaSI । yaTA, pAdme । SrIBImasena uvAca । “pitAmaha ! hyaSakto'hamupavAse karomi kim । ato bahuPalaM brUhi vratamekamapi praBo ! ॥ SrIvyAsa uvAca । vfzasTe miTunasTe'rke SuklA hyekAdaSI hi yA । jyezWe mAsi prayatnena sopozyA jalavarjjitA ॥ snAne cAcamane cEva varjjayitvodakaM buDaH । upayuYjIta nEvAnyadvrataBaNgo'nyaTA Bavet ॥ udyAdadayaM yAvadvarjjayitvA jalaM buDaH । aprayatnAdavApnoti dvAdaSadvAdaSIPalam ॥ tataH praBAte vimale dvAdaSyAM snAnamAcaret । jalaM suvarRaM dattvA tu dvijAtiByo yaTAviDi ॥ BuYjIta kftakftyastu brAhmaREH sahito vaSI । evaM kfte tu yat puRyaM BImasena ! SfRuzva tat ॥ saMvatsarasya yA maDye ekAdaSyo Bavanti hi । tAsAM PalamavApnoti puttra ! me nAtra saMSayaH ॥ iti mAM keSavaH prAha SaNKacakragadADaraH ॥” kiYca । “DanaDAnyavahA puRyA puttraBAgyasuKapradA । upozitA naravyAGra ! iti satyaM bravImi te ॥ yamadUtA mahAkAyAH karAlAH kAmarUpiRaH । daRqapASaDarA rOdrA nopasarpanti taM naram ॥ pItAmbaraDarAH SaNKacakrahastA manojavAH । antakAle nayantyenaM vEzRavA vEzRavIM purIm ॥” kiYca । “toyasya niyamaM yastu kurute vEzRavottamaH । palakowisuvarRasya yAme yAme sa puRyaBAk ॥ snAga dAnaM japaM homaM yadasyAM kurute naraH । tat sarvvaYcAkzayaM prAptametat kfzRasya BAzitam ॥ kiMvApareRa DarmmeRa nirjjalEkAdaSIM nfpa ! । upozya samyagviDinA vEzRavaM padamApnuyAt ॥” kiYca । “yEH kftA BImasenEzA nirjjalEkAdaSI SuBA । svakulaM tAritaM sarvvaM kulAtItaM taTA Satam ॥ AtmanA saha tErnItaM vAsudevasya mandire ॥” kiYca । “AtmadrohaH kftastastu yErezA nahyupozitA । pApAtmAno durAcArA duzwAste nAtra saMSayaH ॥” kiYca । “yaScemAM SfRuyAdBaktyA yaScApi parikIrttayet । uBO tO svargamAptO hi nAtra kAryyA vicAraRA ॥” aTa nirjjalavataviDiH । yaTA, -- “yaTAprAgliKitaM kftvA saNkalpaniyamaM vrate । jalamAdAya gfhRIyAnmantreRAnena vEzRavaH ॥ ekAdaSyAM nirAhAro varjjayizyAmi vE jalam । keSavaprIRanArTAya pratyantadamanena ca ॥” iti ॥ “varjjayeccAmbvahorAtraM vinA cAcamanArTakam । vinA ca prASanaM pAdodakasyAtyantapAvanam ॥ ekAdaSyAM niSAyAntu nityapUjAM viDAya hi । hEmIM trEvikramIM mUrttiM snApayet payaAdiBiH ॥ vastrAdikaM samarpyATAByarccya ganDAdiBiSca tAm । praRamya jAgaraM kuryyAt tadagre narttanAdinA ॥ prAtaHsnAnAdi nirvvatya taM trivikramamarccayet । SaktyAmbukumBAn vipreByo dadyAt ganDAdyalaNkftAn ॥” tatra mantraH । “devadeva hfzIkeSa saMsArArRavatAraka ! । jalakumBapradAnena yAsyAmi paramANgatimiti ॥ dadyAcca kanakaM CatraM vastrayugmamupAnahO । jalapAtrARi divyAni viBave sati vEzRavaH ॥ SaktyA viprAn BojayitvA pItvA BrAtfkarAjjalam । svayaM vAnIya mOnI san BuYjIta saha banDuBiH ॥” iti SrIhariBaktivilAse 15 vilAsaH ॥

tri, (nirgataM jalaM yasmAt .) jalaSUnyadeSAdiH । iti maruSabdawIkAyAM BarataH । 2 । 1 । 5 ॥ yadaktam । sampAptA daSamaDvajAdyagatinA saMmUrcCitA nirjjale turyyadbAdaSavaddvitIyamatimannekAdaSABastanI । sA zazWI nfpapaYcamasya navamaBrUH saptamIvarjjitA prApnotyazwamavedanAM praTama he tasyAstftIyo Bava ॥” iti vallAlasenaH ॥
